Intro: Greetings to the chef. I hope your business is going well. As much as I dislike gossip, Nadezdha is unbearable as of late. She refuses to work.
I cannot understand her pain, for I am lucky. But we both fought for a greater Aijinkova, and now we have it. Is our success still so painful?
Our foreign allies are powerful and desperate for food. We have food and are desperate for power. Now our country is valuable, and it is strong.
We… We haven't made much progress on a cure—our chief doctor has deserted us. But we no longer fear foreign threats, and can focus on our country.
Thanks to our allies, Aijinkova is armed to the teeth. Thanks to people like you, we can maintain our peace. From the bottom of my heart, thank you.
